variants.headline: Still in view: home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A claim to authority becomes especially important to examine when it takes a punitive form. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
